name: Yusraa Ashraf
bio: Yusraa is a dedicated medical student passionate about public health communication and student advocacy. She currently serves as the PRO of her faculty, where she amplifies student voices and drives meaningful engagement. She is committed to using clarity, creativity, and compassion to make an impact. Working to build and promote strong relationships across all levels of the faculty through trust, accountability, and communication, one day at a time.
